The EU AI Act entered into force in phases between 2024 and 2027 because the phased entry was deliberate, ensuring that obligations land as institutional capacity and technology mature [Source: ev-1]. This schedule also serves as a compliance roadmap for the Brussels effect exported to providers worldwide [Source: ev-1].

Regarding what the different deadlines require, the evidence specifies the following application dates for specific obligation categories:
*   Prohibited practices ("unacceptable risk") apply from February 2, 2025 (implied by "prohibited practices... apply from" and date context) [Source: ev-1].
*   General-purpose AI (GPAI) model obligations apply from August 2, 2026 (implied by "general-purpose AI... from" and date context) [Source: ev-1].
*   High-risk system obligations apply from August 2026, with a subset applying from August 2027 (implied by "high-risk system obligations from... with a subset applying from" and date context) [Source: ev-1].

The evidence does not explicitly list the specific content or requirements of the deadlines beyond identifying which risk categories become applicable on those dates.
